description: Image Description: The image shows a sign for a bookstore. The sign is rectangular and attached to a metal frame with a light fixture on top. The background of the sign is white. On the left side, there is an illustration of a stack of books, each with different colored covers. The text on the sign reads "goodlight books" in a stylized, lowercase red font, and below it, "Quality Used Books" in a black serif font. The sky in the background is clear
